components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clearest next action in a host region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--vc-color-accent); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--vc-color-accent); color: var(--vc-color-on-accent); font: 700 12px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 17%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 88%, var(--vc-color-text)); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vc-color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A secondary host action that stays visually behind the content.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--vc-color-border); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--vc-color-text-muted); font: 650 12px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--vc-color-border-strong); background: var(--vc-color-surface-sunken); color: var(--vc-color-text); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vc-color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Rail Item
components.description: A centered desktop destination; active state is a quiet warm signal.
components.html: 空间
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--vc-color-text-muted); font: 650 11px/1.25 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--vc-color-surface-sunken); color: var(--vc-color-text); } .ds-rail-item[data-active] { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 13%, var(--vc-color-surface)); color: var(--vc-color-accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 14%, transparent); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vc-color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mobile Dock Item
components.description: A 56px thumb target for the five-item mobile host Dock.
components.html: 发现
components.css: .ds-dock-item { display: flex; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--vc-color-text-muted); font: 650 11px/1.25 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dock-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-dock-item:hover { background: var(--vc-color-surface-sunken); color: var(--vc-color-text); } .ds-dock-item[data-active] { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 13%, var(--vc-color-surface)); color: var(--vc-color-accent); } .ds-dock-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vc-color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-room { position: relative; display: block; min-height: 310px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-text) 14%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; background: #0d0f0d; color: #eeeae1; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(44 49 40 / 11%); transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-room:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 32px 90px rgb(44 49 40 / 18%); } .ds-room-light { position: absolute; top: -30px; left: 50%; width: 260px; height: 250px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 34%, transparent), transparent); clip-path: polygon(44% 0, 56% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-room-message { position: absolute; top: 43%; left: 8%; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px 14px 14px 5px; background: #fbfcf8; color: #292c27; font: 400 12px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-room footer { position: absolute; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid rgb(238 234 225 / 14%); border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(16 17 15 / 88%); } .ds-room footer span { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-room strong { font: 700 18px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-room small { color: #aaa69a; font: 400 11px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-room:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vc-color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selection Index Row
components.description: A keyboard-operable account or service index item with a physical threshold marker.
components.css: .ds-index-row { position: relative; display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vc-color-border); background: transparent; color: var(--vc-color-text-muted); font: 400 12px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-index-row span { color: var(--vc-color-accent); font-size: 11px; } .ds-index-row strong { font-weight: 650; } .ds-index-row i { position: absolute; right: -4px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 3px solid var(--vc-color-canvas); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; } .ds-index-row:hover, .ds-index-row[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--vc-color-text); } .ds-index-row[aria-selected='true'] i { background: var(--vc-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px color-mix(in oklab, var(--vc-color-accent) 34%, transparent); } .ds-index-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--vc-color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: 灯下房间 / The Lamplit Room
narrative.overview:
The VibeChat host should feel like a bright corridor connecting inhabited rooms: quiet mineral surfaces, clear thresholds, and a small amount of warm light that tells people where life is happening. It is simple and creative rather than decorative, with enough material depth to remain comfortable during long sessions. It must never read as a SaaS dashboard, an editing tool, a magazine spread, or a colorful skin laid over the product.

The host exists to orient people, help them find friends and Spaces, and then step back. Once a running Space opens, its user-controlled App owns the visual world beneath the trusted Kernel. Lamplit styling belongs to the non-Space host and must not recolor, filter, dim, or otherwise compete with Space content.
keyCharacteristics: Bright warm-mineral Light mode with visible but restrained surface separation.
Quiet charcoal Dark mode with low-frequency amber light, designed independently rather than inverted.
Room, doorway, pool-of-light, and threshold cues used as a reusable spatial language.
A slim left rail on desktop and a thumb-reachable bottom Dock on mobile.
Real activity and relationships lead; management controls wait behind deliberate entry points.

rules.name: The Warm Light Rarity Rule
rules.body: Accent color identifies action, focus, active location, or signs of life; it does not fill large decorative regions.

rules.name: The Bright Without Blank Rule
rules.body: Light mode may be bright, but every large region must retain legible depth through tonal separation, a fine boundary, atmosphere, or a soft shadow.

rules.name: The One Sign Rule
rules.body: A viewport gets one dominant display-typography moment. Repeating the display face across every module turns the product into a magazine.

rules.name: The Room, Not Dashboard Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce metric-card grids, marketing heroes, equal-weight plan walls, or persistent management panels when a spatial threshold, sequence, or Finder can express the task.

rules.name: The Recompose Rule
rules.body: Mobile layouts change task order and interaction surface; they are never a shrunken desktop composition.

rules.name: The Threshold Rule
rules.body: Elevation communicates a change in interaction plane. Static page sections do not receive shadows merely to look decorated.

dos: Do use semantic host tokens so Light, Dark, and future themes can change without rewriting page selectors.
Do make activity, relationships, and the next human action visible before management controls.
Do preserve subtle material depth in bright Light mode through nearby tones, boundaries, and low ambient shadows.
Do verify both desktop and 390px mobile layouts, keyboard focus, reduced motion, and 11px minimum visible text.
Do keep the host theme outside the running Space App and beneath the trusted Kernel boundary.
donts: Don't turn host pages into SaaS dashboards, analytics grids, pricing walls, editor chrome, or magazine spreads.
Don't use large colorful decoration or frequent orange fills that compete with Space content.
Don't place desktop primary navigation, search, and account management in a crowded top bar.
Don't treat Dark mode as a mechanical inversion of Light mode.
Don't shrink desktop layouts onto mobile or hide essential navigation in horizontally scrolling strips.
Don't recolor, filter, blur, dim, or otherwise theme user-controlled Space content from the host.
